T: Black suit. Big voice. A long road to June.
D: Johnny Cash goes from an Arkansas cotton farm to Sun Records, pills and Folsom Prison, and keeps asking June Carter to marry him.
P: Pour the yellow water lemonade when Cash smashes his glass at Folsom.
S: Spiced roasted peanuts by the handful. John keeps snatching June's peanut.
Toss the peanuts with the oil and spread on a tray. Roast at 180C, shaking once, until golden. Toss hot with the paprika, cayenne, sugar and salt, then cool a little.
Dyess farm biscuits and sausage gravy
Buttermilk biscuits with sausage gravy, J.R.'s boyhood on the Dyess cotton farm.

Rub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt, then stir in the buttermilk to a soft dough. Pat out 3cm thick, cut 8 rounds and bake at 220C until risen and golden. Brown the sausage mince, breaking it up, then stir in the plain flour. Whisk in the milk and simmer until thick, then season with plenty of pepper. Split the biscuits and ladle over the gravy.
M: Butter and sage roast turkey, Thanksgiving at the Hendersonville lake house.

Rub the turkey with half the butter, the sage and salt, and roast at 180C until the juices run clear. Soften the onion and celery in the rest of the butter, then mix with the cornbread, egg and 250ml stock. Bake the stuffing in a dish alongside the turkey for the last 35 minutes. Rest the turkey, stir the flour into the pan juices, whisk in the rest of the stock and simmer to a gravy. Slice and serve with the stuffing, gravy and cranberry sauce.
250ml chicken stock, plus 250ml for the gravy@Pantry
Dry-rub ribs, slow cooked. The audition for Sam Phillips at Sun Records.

Mix the sugar, spices and 2 tsp salt and rub all over the ribs. Wrap in foil with a splash of the vinegar and bake at 150C until tender. Unwrap, sprinkle with a little more rub and roast at 220C until crusted. Toss the cabbage with the mayo and the rest of the vinegar. Cut the ribs and serve with the slaw.
W: Ring of Fire cinnamon bundt cake
Cinnamon bundt cake with a glossy glaze. June writes Ring of Fire about John.

Beat the butter and brown sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour and half the cinnamon, alternating with the buttermilk. Spoon into a greased bundt tin and bake at 170C until a skewer comes out clean. Whisk the icing sugar, milk, the rest of the cinnamon and the cayenne, and pour over the cooled ring.
K: Fresh lemonade, like the yellow water Cash smashes.
Simmer the barley in the water with the lemon peel. Strain, stir in the sugar to dissolve and cool. Add the lemon juice and pour over ice.
